sources.title: Meta Muse Glimmer Fits a Full AI Agent Inside Your Gaming PC
sources.snippet: Meta's Muse Glimmer is a 30B open-source AI model that runs on a single consumer GPU. It beats larger rivals on agentic benchmarks and costs nothing to download.
